paper.core_task: Unsupervised reinforcement learning exploration and downstream task adaptation using diffusion models

contributions.name: A diffusion-based model for unsupervised RL exploration
contributions.author_claim_text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to introduce diffusion models into unsupervised RL, enabling accurate modeling of heterogeneous state distributions and defining a score-based intrinsic reward that substantially improves exploration.
contributions.description: The method uses diffusion models to estimate the state distribution from a replay buffer and defines a score-based intrinsic reward to guide exploration of under-visited states.

contributions.name: An alternating optimization for diffusion policy fine-tuning
contributions.author_claim_text: Beyond exploration, ExDM develops an efficient decoupled training scheme and a finetuning algorithm for adapting pre-trained diffusion components to downstream tasks under limited interaction, with theoretical guarantees of convergence and optimality.
contributions.description: The method proposes an alternating optimization procedure to fine-tune diffusion policies for downstream tasks, supported by theoretical convergence guarantees.

novelty_claims.text: The integration of diffusion models into URL is innovative, leveraging their strong density estimation capabilities to model complex, non-stationary state distributions—a critical challenge in URL.
Introducing diffusion models to URL is impactful, but novelty is diluted by omissions in related work and incomplete comparisons.
